title: Ethiopian Grilled Vegetable Bowl
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Grilled Vegetable Bowl — berbere-marinated and grilled zucchini, eggplant, bell pepper, and sweet potato over teff injera pieces with hummus-style shiro, beetroot salad, and green chilli paste. The modern plant-based Ethiopian bowl.
longDesc: The Ethiopian grilled vegetable bowl applies the berbere tradition to charcoal-grilled vegetables — each vegetable absorbs the berbere marinade and caramelises on the grill, producing a plant-based bowl of genuine depth.
steps: Toss vegetables in berbere and oil.
Grill over high heat until charred on edges and tender.
Spoon thick shiro in the centre.
Add beetroot salad. Dot green chilli paste.
chefTips: Each vegetable needs different grill time — sweet potato longest, zucchini shortest.
cookingScience: See ETH085 for berbere caramelisation science.
sustainabilityTips: All vegetables — locally grown Ethiopian produce.
culturalNote: The Ethiopian grilled vegetable bowl is the modern café's commitment to showing that plant-based Ethiopian food can be as visually beautiful and gastronomically interesting as the meat dishes.
